app.name: Grammarly: AI Keyboard & Notes
app.description: Grammarly's AI-powered keyboard and notes app helps you write clearly and correctly across all your apps and documents.

verdict.one_liner: Useful writing tools, but extensive tracking and AI training on your content warrant careful consideration.
verdict.summary: Grammarly: AI Keyboard & Notes is a productivity app that processes everything you type on its servers to provide writing suggestions. While the company explicitly avoids using your actual content for advertising, it does engage in significant behavioral tracking and targeted advertising using your account information and usage patterns. The app offers opt-outs for AI training and targeted ads, and uses third-party processors for payments. Users should be aware that their writing is sent to company servers and may be used for AI model training unless disabled.
verdict.recommendation_reason: While Grammarly offers useful writing tools and some privacy controls, the app's extensive data collection, AI training on personal content, and targeted advertising practices mean users should carefully consider whether the benefits outweigh the privacy risks. The opt-outs are helpful but require active user management.

red.title: AI trains on your writing
red.plain_english: The app uses your emails, documents, and other writing to train its AI models, unless you manually turn this off in settings.

red.title: Your data fuels targeted ads
red.plain_english: The company turns your email address and phone number into special codes that advertising partners use to show you ads on other websites.

red.title: Data shared with many partners
red.plain_english: Your data is shared with advertising partners, marketplace apps, and other companies in the Superhuman corporate family.

red.title: Tracks your device in detail
red.plain_english: The app collects a detailed list of what other apps you have installed, your browser plugins, and other device information.

red.title: Everything typed goes to their servers
red.plain_english: Everything you type, upload, or dictate in the app is sent to company servers for processing.

green.title: Writing not used for ads
green.plain_english: The company explicitly promises it does not use your actual writing or documents to show you advertisements.

green.title: You can opt out of AI training
green.plain_english: You can choose whether the app uses your content to train its AI models by adjusting a setting in your account.

green.title: Targeted ad opt-out available
green.plain_english: You can opt out of targeted advertising and cookie tracking through the 'Your Privacy Choices' link.

green.title: Uses encryption and security
green.plain_english: The company uses encryption, secure networks, and limits access to protect your data.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The app does not access your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The privacy policy makes no mention of camera or microphone access. As a keyboard and notes app, these permissions are not required for core functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: No mention of camera or microphone access in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app may infer your approximate location from your IP address and timezone settings for technical and personalization purposes.
categories.detail: The policy states they collect 'time zone setting and location' as part of technical information, and explicitly mention inferring approximate location from IP address.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may make inferences about your approximate location based on your IP address
concerns: Location inferred from IP address
Used for personalization and advertising

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you choose to, the app can access your contacts to improve spelling suggestions, but this information is not used for marketing or shared with others.
categories.detail: Users can optionally give the app access to contacts for spelling suggestions. The policy states this information is only used to provide products and will not be used to contact, advertise, or market to non-users.
categories.policy_excerpt: if you choose to give our products access to your contacts so our editing products make appropriate spelling suggestions. We use the contact information... only to provide our products to you and will not use it to contact, advertise, or market to such individuals.
concerns: Contact access is optional but data is collected

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The app accesses the files, documents, and text you upload or allow it to access so it can provide writing and editing help.
categories.detail: As a keyboard and notes app, Grammarly accesses user content including text, documents, files, calendars, images, and data that you upload or enable access to.
categories.policy_excerpt: We receive the content you upload or enable our products to access, such as emails and drafts, text, documents, files, calendars, images, data, and any other content you allow our products to access.
concerns: User content is processed on company servers
Broad access to files and data

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared with advertising partners, service providers, and marketplace participants. The company may also transfer your information during a merger or sale.
categories.detail: Data is shared with Superhuman family companies, trusted service providers, marketplace participants (when user integrates), advertising partners for targeted ads, government/legal authorities, and in mergers/sales. User content is explicitly not shared with advertising companies.
categories.policy_excerpt: We engage other companies to serve advertisements promoting our products... We do not make user content available to these companies... we may work with advertising partners to translate your email address or phone number into a unique identifier that such partners can then use to show ads promoting our products on other websites and online services.
concerns: Advertising partners receive unique identifiers derived from email/phone
Data shared with marketplace participants based on user integrations
Corporate family has broad access
Data may be transferred in mergers or acquisitions

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: The app collects your name, email, job title, and phone number, and uses this information to build a profile for advertising and marketing purposes.
categories.detail: Account information includes email, password, name, job titles, phone numbers, and SSO data. This data is used for marketing, advertising, and to create inferences about interests and industry. Email and phone numbers are also hashed into unique IDs for ad targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: we do use some of the other information we collect (such as your email address... your usage data, and inferences we may have made about you) to send marketing communications, advertise our products to you on third-party sites and services
concerns: Account data used for targeted advertising
Inferences about personal interests and industry created
Email/phone converted to unique IDs for ad partners

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app tracks your online activity and uses your data to show you targeted ads on other websites, though you can opt out.
categories.detail: The company uses cookies, pixels, usage data, and technical information to serve targeted advertisements on third-party sites. They translate email addresses and phone numbers into unique identifiers for ad targeting. Users can opt out via 'Your Privacy Choices'.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may work with advertising partners to translate your email address or phone number into a unique identifier that such partners can then use to show ads promoting our products on other websites and online services.
concerns: Email and phone numbers hashed for cross-site ad targeting
Cookies and pixels used for tracking
Targeted ads shown on third-party websites
Opt-out is per-browser/device, not universal

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app is not intended for children under 13, but the privacy policy does not include strong child-specific protections.
categories.detail: The policy states they do not engage in sales/sharing/targeted advertising for anyone under 18, but there is no explicit COPPA or GDPR-K compliance statement. The app is a general productivity tool, not child-directed.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not engage in sales, sharing, or targeted advertising using personal information about anyone we know to be under the age of 18.
concerns: No explicit child-directed safeguards mentioned
No age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app monitors how you use it and what apps you have installed, and uses this information to predict your interests and show you ads.
categories.detail: Usage data includes activity on websites and apps, features used, read receipts, security logs, and marketplace interactions. Technical info includes apps installed on device. This data is used for profiling and advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect usage data about how you interact with us and our products, including your activity on our websites and apps... We also collect data about how you interact with our online marketplace
concerns: Extensive usage monitoring including apps installed
Activity data used for profiling and targeted ads
Read receipts collected

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects detailed information about your device and browser, including what other apps you have installed, and uses this to recognize you across sessions and for advertising.
categories.detail: Technical information includes IP address, device type, browser type/version, apps installed on device, timezone, location, browser plugins, OS, and platform. Cookies are used to recognize browser/device.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect technical information about your device and how you access our products. This includes your IP address, device type, browser type and version, apps installed on your device, time zone setting and location, browser plugin types and versions, operating system, and platform.
concerns: Apps installed on device are collected
Browser plugins collected
Cookies used to recognize device across sessions
Data used for advertising purposes

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No mention of health or biometric data collection in the privacy policy.
categories.policy_excerpt: No mention of health or biometric data.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: If you make a purchase, your payment information is handled by a third-party processor and the app itself does not store your card details.
categories.detail: Payment information is processed by third-party payment processors. The app collects transaction information but does not directly handle payment details.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you make a purchase or payment with us, we collect information about the transaction, and our third-party payment processor will handle your payment information.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request to access, correct, or delete your data, and opt out of AI training and targeted ads. However, some data may be kept for legal and business reasons.
categories.detail: Users have rights to access, correct, and delete personal data. AI training opt-out and targeted advertising opt-out are available. However, data is retained 'for as long as necessary to provide our products' and for 'other legitimate business purposes' including legal obligations and disputes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Depending on where you live, you may have rights under privacy laws to access, correct, or delete your personal data... We retain personal data for as long as necessary to provide our products to you, to complete the transactions you have requested, to comply with our legal obligations, to resolve disputes, and for other legitimate business purposes.
concerns: Data retained for 'legitimate business purposes' beyond providing service
Deletion process not clearly described for all data types

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: If the company makes important changes to this privacy policy, they will send you an email to let you know.
categories.detail: Material changes to the privacy policy trigger additional notice, such as email notification. No requirement for active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes, we will provide you additional notice, such as by sending you an email.
concerns: No requirement for active re-agreement to changed terms
